title: Metric Markov cotype of ℓ₁
description: OpenAI's answer (2026) to a question of Mendel and Naor: the space ℓ₁ has metric Markov cotype two. The course compares geometric and uniform averages of time along stationary Markov chains, writes finite subsets of ℓ₁ through weighted cuts, proves a flatness inequality for the cubic 3r²−2r³, and builds the required points from a killed random walk; they turn out to be expected medians of three stopped-walk endpoints.
